## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 08.09.2026 - 16.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Anthony Smith_, 16.09.2026, 1/5: "I haven't used the app in some time. As a matter of fact I uninstalled the app due to me finding another app. Unfortunately the app didn't give me the option to cancel my subscription and I'm still getting charged for something I don't have so, my ratings are changing and my subscription needs to be canceled immediately"
            2. _Erin Love_, 15.09.2026, 1/5: "I have canceled my subscription through Google Play. Store, as the app requires you to do. And I'm still being charged month after month. Getting to customer service, there's no easy way. How some of the reviews on here are so high, It's unbelievable. There's no easy way to cancel your account. The only way I can see is to cancel the account through google play service and then turn around and block each and every charge."
            3. _Arlene Mingils_, 14.09.2026, 1/5: "Not clear on pricing! Beware ⚠️. I never received an answer on how much I was being charged!! I was just told that they would cancel my subscription 😡"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      2 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 13.06.2026 - 14.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Mel_, 13.06.2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Wanda Fay_, 14.09.2026, 4/5: "How do I get the Print out sheet for Tai Chi Chair Yoga? Can't find it in the Lasta App? Did My first workout and I have to say it was a lot more difficult than I thought it would be. I have Balance issues so it makes it more difficult for me."
            3. _Liz_, 13.09.2026, 4/5: "the experience has been very interesting. had a little issue but with some great help from the support section especially from Lily Cole everything was sorted out very quickly. many thanks Lily"
<!--/ir-theme-->
